name: Presenter Studio
description: Talking-to-camera videos with lip-synced speech: YouTube explainers, UGC ads, testimonials and spokesperson videos. Writes the script, uses the user's photo of the presenter or casts a fictional one with Nano Banana Pro, speaks the script (or uses the user's own recording) and lip-syncs the presenter to it. Voice (Kokoro) and lip-sync (Ditto) run free on the local machine.

execution.service_target: engines/presenter_engine.py (local Ditto + Kokoro; fal models only with PRESENTER_PAID=on)

source.license: Apache-2.0 (Ditto's InsightFace face detector: non-commercial research)

best_for: YouTube-style explainer videos with a person talking to camera
UGC ads: a creator holding the product and talking to a phone camera
lip-syncing a photo of a person to the user's own voice recording
not_good_for: films with several locations or scenes (one presenter, one framing; long speech is joined with jump cuts)
lip-syncing an existing video of a person
several people talking to each other
profile_notes: Added 2026-11-13. Free by default: voice Kokoro (Apache-2.0, local CPU; English, Hindi, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Portuguese, Chinese) and lip-sync Ditto (Apache-2.0, local Apple GPU or CPU), installed with tools/local_lipsync/setup.sh. Presenter photo: the user's, else Nano Banana Pro on fal (paid, cents). PRESENTER_PAID=on adds ElevenLabs and fal lip-sync (Kling AI Avatar v2, LongCat, InfiniteTalk) as fallbacks. Speech is cut at pauses into parts of at most 27 s and joined with jump cuts. Test quality: up to 15 s; full: up to 180 s. No captions yet.
